d:
Kangres ki varishth neta soniya gandhi ka itli men sthit ghar ek sikh karobari sukhdev sinh kang ne kharida hai. aakhirkar sukhdev sinh kang ko soniya gandhi ka ghar kharidne men dilchaspi kyon jagi, vo kis tarah itli men us ghar tak pahunche aur vo soniya gandhi se kya guzarish karte hain? dekhie bibisi ke sahyogi ravindar sinh robin ki sukhdev sinh kang ke sath yah khas batchit.
BBC World Service ke nae aip ko daunlod karen.
BBC News hindi ko chunen aur paie nyuz alart, laiv tivi, podkast... sab ek jagah.
(kripya not karen: naya aip briten aur amerika men uplabdh nahin hai.)
